.Notes
[[smc-components-note-1]]^[1]^ Only the harts of the CPU cluster reach this unit. An access from outside the cluster answers the same at every address in its aperture. +
[[smc-components-note-2]]^[2]^ A read fetches the whole 8-byte word, so a read of 0x4C also reads NEXT_ID_0 at 0x48 and launches a transfer. +
[[smc-components-note-3]]^[3]^ Each instance implements 16 DAT and 16 DCT entries: the DAT at 0x400-0x7FF repeats every 0x80 bytes, the DCT at 0x800-0xFFF repeats every 0x100 bytes, and DCT writes are dropped. +
[[smc-components-note-4]]^[4]^ A write answers SLVERR and leaves the ROM unchanged. +
[[smc-components-note-5]]^[5]^ No RTL decodes this aperture. +
[[smc-components-note-6]]^[6]^ 0x544, 0x102C and 0x202C are the upper halves of live 64-bit words, so a 64-bit read there returns live data.
